best_section.where: second chunk, alongside the bowls/croquet greens, about 85 m before the Sir Fred Schonell Drive junction

drivers.road: Narrow residential lane running past the UQ sports grounds, not a through route; only picks up traffic noise near the Sir Fred Schonell Drive end.
drivers.room_and_convention: Cars are parked nose-to-tail along this whole kerb in both image sets, well clear of any crossing or driveway at the chosen spot.
drivers.houses: No house fronts near the kerb here — oval and bowls greens on one side, a school/leisure building on the other; nearest houses are set well back across the sports field.

flags: OSM tags say parking:both=no but the signs clearly say P (No Limit) along most of this stretch — trust the signs.
South end (last ~20 m) sits right at the Sir Fred Schonell Drive junction with crossings and traffic-area signage — avoid parking that close to the end.
sun_shade: Mostly shaded — dense tree canopy overhangs the kerb from the east (oval/building) side for most of this section.
cannot_judge: Exact sign placement at the 225-253 m mark vs the surveyed sign list
summary: Quiet lane by the UQ ovals with cars already parked along the kerb and no houses close by.
reasons: Parked cars confirm kerbside parking is normal
Oval and school screen the nearest houses
Flat here, steep hill is elsewhere on the kerb
